Subject: Re: Payee legal name change — invoice 0921 on hold / what do you need from us?

Hi Lena — thanks for the note and the attachments.

Short answers up front: please resubmit a completed, signed W-9 with the new legal name exactly as you want it to appear on our remittance records (we can accept a scanned PDF). We do request EIN verification for entity name changes; an IRS CP575 or a 147C is ideal, but if you only have a bank letter with the EIN and corporate formation docs we'll accept those as interim proof while we process.

A couple of clarifying asks so Marissa (AP) and Marcus (Legal) are set:
- Exact legal name to appear on our records: please confirm if "BlueForge Bio, Inc." is the full legal name to use for 1099/EIN purposes.
- Is the operating taxpayer classification the same (C-corp / S-corp / LLC)? That impacts 1099 treatment.
- If you're providing a notarized W-9, please include the notary certificate as a separate page (we've seen some submit the notary stamp embedded on the signature page which makes processing slower).

How we'll proceed on our side: once we receive the signed W-9 + EIN evidence, Marissa will re-run payee validation and update the remittance name in our AP system. If everything is in order, our typical settlement window is within 7–10 business days from validation (we'll confirm an exact release date after validation). If there's anything time-sensitive (e.g., a cashflow cutoff this week), flag it and we'll escalate.

You can either attach the documents to a reply here or I can send a DocuSign envelope and our payee-change form if you prefer.

Olga
Olga Petrov

Lena — quick note from Legal on acceptable evidence and a couple of downstream requirements: 

1) Acceptable evidence for name + EIN change (in order of preference):
   - IRS CP575 / IRS Letter 147C showing EIN and legal name; OR
   - Signed W-9 (Form W-9) with handwritten or PAd signature + separate notarization certificate; AND one of the following: certified articles of incorporation showing the new name, OR a recent bank letter on bank letterhead that includes your EIN.
2) If BlueForge wishes to change remittance bank details at the same time, we require:
   - A completed ACH Authorization form (we can provide), plus a voided check OR bank letter on letterhead confirming the routing/account.
   - A short confirmation call (5–10 min) between BlueForge finance and our AP to confirm the routing (standard anti‑fraud control).
3) 1099 treatment: please confirm your taxpayer classification. If you are incorporated (Inc.), you are typically exempt from 1099 unless otherwise noted. If you're an LLC treated as a disregarded entity/sole proprietor, we'll classify as 1099-eligible. 

DocuSign: Olga, please send the internal payee-change envelope to Lena (we'll include the AP form + DocuSign W-9 template). Lena, once you sign in DocuSign we can fast-track validation.

If you'd prefer to upload the signed W-9 + notary PDF directly to the secure form (https://app.redwood.ai/docs/payee-change-form) send us the link and we'll pick up the docs.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Counsel, Commercial | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
